digest.title: When did Google get so weird?
Owed a billion dollars in Nvidia stock
Microsoft drops Copilot+ branding from its new laptops
OpenAI agents tried to ‘bruteforce’ a UN website
digest.tldr: Security researcher Rowan Howard-Jones says that OpenAI agents scanned the UN Conference on Trade and Development's (UNCTAD) statistics site over 16,000 times between April and June.
